title: <skillDir>/.skill-meta.json — living-skill lifecycle metadata
description: Written by kernel/lib/living.js enable/regenerate/reset and stamped by install/uninstall.js --for-upgrade. TRACKED (it belongs to the founder's project, not to the runtime). ⛔ ITS ABSENCE IS NOT A FAILURE: a skill with no meta is STATIC, which living status reports as NOT_APPLICABLE and which the docs call a completely supported state. Living behaviour applies to three opt-in canaries (debug, savepoint, knowledge) and to nothing else — deliberately NOT the same set as the skills shipping a SKILL.base.md, because enabling a canary is what creates its baseline.

schemaVersion.description: Presence-checked by status(): a meta missing this, baseHash or overlayBudgetLines is CANNOT_DETERMINE, never a quiet pass.

supersededByUpgrade.description: ⛔ THE HONEST NARROWING. An upgrade does NOT preserve a living overlay — a founder who upgrades wants the new pack skill — so the living form is ARCHIVED and the loss is REPORTED, rather than the overlay silently vanishing under a clean PASS. Bounded at five archives; at the bound the upgrade refuses to remove the living form and says so.
